title: ID0428107-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002830] Modbus failure
description:
Reported issue:
We are currently observing a large number of failures of charging points with firmware 7.0.5. There is a Modbus connection loss error, which shortly afterwards ends in unavailable charging points. What is this Modbus connection loss related to? We do not use Modbus in combination with an external load management with these chargers. Please be sure to analyze and report back.
Solution: NA

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0428107-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002830] Modbus failure CRM:01811000775
additional_info.body:
Hello Oliver Zimmermann,
Thanks for your response.
The error occured only once it means the error active for only 5sec.
The VendorErrorCode “
secc is offline
” refers to the happening of the coap polling error, an internal communication to SECC lost for a small interval of time. The OpenController will reconnect to the SECC within 5 seconds. Also in this case, this event has no impact on the charger, even during charging session.
Hope you satisfied with provided answer.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
